I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message to confirm the number: the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 268 seats.

I couldn't check that figure against anything. I can't see any Marrow Fieldworks account files on the share, and I have nowhere to keep notes between conversations, so their channel message is the only record. I told Hollis that if the seat count should go into the account's CRM or profile file, someone with access to those files will need to add it.
